title: Excel Saga
titleNative: エクセル・サーガ
synopsis: Earnest young girls Excel and Hyatt (both codenames) hold down minimum-wage jobs to support their true avocation: trying to conquer the city of Fukuoka for the secret organization ACROSS and its dreamy dictator, Il Palazzo--a man whose dignity is such that he could never acknowledge that ACROSS consists of himself, a leaky basement, two unpaid teenage interns, and a stray dog. But society is all to blame, as creator Rikdo Koshi takes aim at everything from organized religion to public television, in a manga that makes reindeer spit blood and puts puppies on the dinner menu. (Source: VIZ Media) Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

title: Mimi's Tales of Terror
titleNative: ミミの怪談
synonyms: Las historias de fantasmas de Mimi
synopsis: University student Mimi and her boyfriend Naoto encounter one chilling mystery after another. There’s the enigmatic neighbor woman dressed in black from head to toe—but if she’s so odd, why does it seems like there are many others like her? Then, whose eyes track Mimi’s movements from the cemetery next door? And why does a bizarre red circle drawn on a basement wall change with each passing day? Nine scary stories that really happened, drawn from the famed collection of urban legends Shin Mimibukuro (New Earmuffs), and adapted into manga by horror genius Junji Ito! Chapter 1: On the Utility Pole Chapter 2: The Woman Next Door Chapter 3: Rustling in the Grass Chapter 4: Grave Placement Chapter 5: Seashore Chapter 6: Just the Two of Us Chapter 7: Scarlet Circle Chapter 8: Sign in the Field Chapter 9: Monster Prop (Source: VIZ Media)

To secure her a spot among the “Hime 6,” the prestigious titles awarded only to the top six candidates in Himegasaki Academy’s famous general election. Determined to claim the throne, Ayane leverages Yuma's weakness to make him “conquer” her rival princess candidates to clear the path to her victory. But winning over the school’s most captivating beauties is no easy task, and Yuuma struggles at every turn… Worse still, as he gets involved with the girls, he finds himself getting tangled up in the increasingly complicated romantic lives of the princesses themselves! With egos laid bare and love and scheming colliding at full force, the most chaotic romantic comedy ever is about to begin! (Source: SB Creative, translated)

title: Himuro no Tenchi: Fate/school Life
titleNative: 氷室の天地 Fate/school life
synopsis: Fate/school life is a comedy 4-koma manga revolving around the normal life at school of the minor characters of Fate/stay night and Fate/Hollow Ataraxia, specifically the character Himuro Kane, classmate of Fate/stay night protagonist Emiya Shirou. This manga by Mashin Eiichirou is a spin-off that tells the normal school life of the supporting characters Himuro Kane, Makidera Kaede, Saegusa Yukika. Other characters are the regular cast of the main games: Mitsuzuri Ayako, Tohsaka Rin, Ryuudou Issei, Matou Shinji, Emiya Shirou, Kuzuki Souichirou, Fujimura Taiga, Matou Sakura, Mitsuzuri Minori; "guest" characters from other series Ciel, Seven, Sajyou Ayaka (formerly the heroine of the never finished prototype novel of Fate/stay night) are also featured, and other classmates Gotou Gai, Fujimoto, Dezaki, Hirumata. The story is centered around classic school events such as a ball game tournament, field trips and inter high school competitions. As such, there is no reference at all to supernatural things like magecraft and Heroic Spirits. br> Note: Includes 18 extra chapters.
